Inside a silicon chip

A silicon chip can contain billions of transistors. Chip engineers design how those switches work together, verify the circuit and lay out the components on the chip. These skills support India’s investment in semiconductor manufacturing.

From FPGA circuits to a chip layout

The proposed projects are shown by year. Ask admissions for the latest curriculum.

  1. Year 1 Digital circuits

    Run and test the circuits you design on programmable FPGA boards.

  2. Year 2 Processor core

    Design a core that fetches and executes instructions.

  3. Year 3 Circuit design and verification

    Verify digital logic and work with analog and mixed-signal circuits.

  4. Year 4 Complete chip design

    Take a chip from specification to physical layout, then spend a semester in supervised engineering work.

Circuit design, verification and layout

The proposed curriculum starts with semiconductor devices and digital and analog circuits. Use Verilog and SystemVerilog for digital design and verification, then study computer architecture and physical design with industry tools.

Where it leads

Explore work in RTL design, design verification, physical design, analog and mixed-signal design, and semiconductor validation.

For those who want the detail

An FPGA is a programmable chip. It lets you test a digital design on hardware while the design is still in development. Verification checks that the logic meets its specification, and physical design determines where to place and connect the components on silicon.

See the assessment approach

Common questions

What does VLSI stand for?

Very-large-scale integration. It is the design of complex circuits that integrate large numbers of transistors onto a single chip.
